title: Me and my brother made a little detective game with Claude, free to play, looking for feedback
author: Thuggish_Games
selftext:
Me and my brother have been making a game with Claude for a while now and it’s finally at a point where other people can play it, so we’ve put a demo up on itch.

It’s called Generic South London Mystery. You play Max, who’s late for the football at his mate Harry’s flat upstairs, and when he gets there things are not right. You talk to the neighbours, write stuff in your notebook and pin it all up on a wall at home with red string until it starts making sense. It’s pixel art and set in a pretty grim 70s council block.

It’s free and runs in the browser. It works on phones too, there are touch controls, and you can use an Xbox or PlayStation controller if you’d rather.

Mostly we just want to know what people think. If something’s confusing, broken, too slow, or you got stuck somewhere, we’d really like to hear it. Same if you enjoyed it, we’d like to know which bits worked.

[https://thuggish-games.itch.io/generic-south-london-mystery](https://thuggish-games.itch.io/generic-south-london-mystery)

Cheers

comments.author: Maple-Syrup89
comments.body:
Love the concept, looks really well styled with a lot of consistency visually. 

Good trailer too. Reveals just enough to want to find out more.  "Somebody is lying" is maybe the single best part of the whole thing as suspense builds. How much of the narrative is you and your bro, vs AI there as well?

replies.author: Thuggish_Games
replies.body:
Thanks for the feedback :)

The story was created by me. Always loved detective/social deduction style games in general. Also games with multiple endings, so tried to incorporate that into the game. I’ve created a narrative for a follow up from this story and started building that too.

comments.author: Top-Maximum2410
comments.body:
Just finished a play through on here. Really loved the art style and overall feel of the game. The dialogue is gripping and enjoyed the secret ending I found🐦‍⬛

I did notice a few things that could be fixed, namely, the clock being out of sync with game time and a loop on one of the background screens

replies.author: Thuggish_Games
replies.body:
Thank you for playing and your feedback :)

We will look at the clocks in game and implement a fix. I think I know which secret ending you are talking about! That’s my personal favourite😂

comments.author: redditisawesomee
comments.body: Great looking game. Are you planning to monetize it through steam or mobile appstore ?

replies.author: Thuggish_Games
replies.body:
Thanks! I spent quite a lot of time trying to get the art style right so appreciate that :)

The current plan is to just to try and gain some interest for the project, we are currently developing a second case that continues the story and the current plan is to make that free too. If people enjoy it and there is a demand we will look to put it on steam and mobile app stores.

comments.author: OneDay_OneLife
comments.body: Did you make the art yourself, or all designed through claude?

replies.author: Thuggish_Games
replies.body:
It was a combination of knowing the style we were after, by discussing with Claude. Then getting Claude to create a prompt for nano banana 2. Taking the image that produced and running it back through Claude to draw the art based on the reference image.

We then created an Art Bible document which was used for any further art that was produced.
